headline: Last session: Nifty reclaims 23,000 as Sensex gains 308 points; IndiGo and HCLTech lead the rally

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.

why: Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 level while Sensex gained 308 points in the last trading session
IndiGo shares jumped 4% and HCLTech rose 2% during Friday's market activity
Strong weekly performance saw the Sensex and Nifty50 rise by approximately 2% overall
Positive corporate earnings, such as those from Muthoot Finance, boosted investor sentiment
whatHappening: Muthoot Finance reported a 27% rise in Q2 profit to ₹2,977 crore with income up 37%
The NCLT scrapped a land transfer deal and cancelled a ₹525 crore transaction involving IIFL
Trent led a broader market rally as the Nifty Smallcap 100 index jumped 4% over the week
Geopolitical reports indicate potential US-Iran peace talks in Doha following Qatar mediation
summary: In the last trading session, the Nifty reclaimed the 23,000 mark as the Sensex gained 308 points, led by strong performances from IndiGo and HCLTech. Muthoot Finance reported robust Q2 earnings growth, while Trent contributed to a 2% weekly rise for major indices. Markets are currently closed for the weekend and will resume trading on Tuesday, 3 November.
